Yes. The manual says to "use only one of the supplied power cords for this welder" (manual p.6), which means more than one cord comes with it. The parts list (manual p.46) shows both a 120 VAC Power Cord (part 55, qty 1) and a 240 VAC Power Cord (part 61, qty 1).

You pick the one that matches your outlet and plug it into the Power Input socket on the back. The plug fits only one way (manual p.16).

- **Receptacle:** It must be properly grounded and GFCI protected. For 120V, the manual says "20 amp rated" (manual p.16).
- **Breaker:** The circuit needs a delayed action-type circuit breaker or fuses (manual p.16).
- **Extension cords:** Don't use one. The manual says "Do not use an extension cord on this welder" (manual p.6).
